name: LLMCheck: Apple M3 Ultra (512GB), MLX, GLM 5.2 753B-A40B Q4_K_M decode
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LLMCheck open dataset). M3 Ultra 512GB, MLX, GLM 5.2 753B-A40B Q4_K_M, TTFT 2.0 s, per-request.
notes: Q4_K_M row: 753B at 4-bit needs ~400GB for weights alone — only the 512GB SKU has the headroom, and decode is ~15 tok/s. The IQ1_S row (22 tok/s) shows the quant-vs-speed lever.
